purpose: story 1.13 — the Day-0 viewing-key derivation bug, verified at upstream HEAD and filed

bugs.what: residues 0, HALF_ORDER, HALF_ORDER+1 have no legal (k, ORDER-k) representative; the fold remaps residue 0 to key 1 silently and emits contract-rejected keys for the other two
assertViewingKey uses starknet.js num.assertInRange, inclusive on both bounds, so it admits k == MAX_VIEWING_KEY == HALF_ORDER, which is_canonical_key rejects (strict <)

contractRule: 1 <= k < HALF_ORDER, strict — privacy.cairo:259-260 (ZERO_PRIVATE_KEY, PRIVATE_KEY_NOT_CANONICAL) + utils.cairo:273-276 (is_canonical_key), identical at pinned commit and HEAD

dupCheck.how: gh search issues/prs on the repo for: viewing key, canonical, deriveViewingKey, HALF_ORDER, assertInRange, range, assertViewingKey
dupCheck.result: no existing issue or PR reports the fold or the off-by-one; filed fresh

ourFix: packages/protocol/src/identity.ts — canonicalizeViewingKey folds the strict upper half and throws on the three unrepresentable residues (assertViewingKey enforces the contract's strict bound)
